reviews.text: We've tried all the services: the daycare, the hotel, and the hair salon. We love them all; excellent work, my little ones love going. Highly recommended!

We have been using this dog hotel for a while now, and it is consistently our top choice in the area. Whenever we drop off our dog here, the staff takes such wonderful care of them. The team is warm, attentive, and genuinely loves animals. It gives us total peace of mind knowing our dog is safe, happy, and well looked after. Highly recommended for anyone in Roma Norte and Condesa!
Excellent service

Highly recommended!!! The way they treat the dogs is amazing, and they keep you updated with videos all day long! The facilities are incredible, and there are tons of activities for you to do when you leave them at the hotel. It's a personalized service so your dog has a blast. Manola is a very wary dog, but she wasn't scared at all with them. 1000000/10

Mochi was very happy and comfortable here. She enjoyed both the daycare and the boarding, and thanks to you, our month-long trip to Mexico City with our dog was a wonderful experience.

It's clear you care for the dogs with so much love and dedication. We sincerely appreciate your kindness, your attention, and all the thoughtful touches you gave Mochi. We leave with complete peace of mind and immense gratitude.

100% recommended! We will definitely return when we go back to Mexico City.
We've been leaving Chava at Mon Ami Dogi for a long time now, and they take care of her and pamper her just like she's at home. There's no better place for our dogs.
They're great, they send you videos of your dog all day long

My dog ​​has been going to the kennel for six months and occasionally to the hotel. They also bathe her regularly there, and I have no complaints. They always send photos and/or videos of how Coco is doing. They have special days with activities, which really helps Coco learn basic commands. She always comes home happy and tired because she spends the whole day playing with other dogs or the staff. Coco is always excited to leave home for the kennel. As for the hotel itself, it's very good. They send photos of her sleeping area and videos of her eating. She's always spotless after her baths, with a beautiful coat. I've never had any problems with the staff or other dogs. I highly recommend it.
Average; they made me go to an appointment and then canceled it at the last minute. Generally good service…
The best place to leave your dog! They do different activities for them every day and take great care of them!

Left out baby for a month and was worried but now when we are back we are happy we choose them. Regular video update and have had a great time with they. They really took care of him like his own home.
Excellent service 10/10

Mon Ami Dogi is a wonderful experience for your furry friend!

Whether you leave them at our daycare for a few hours, request our grooming service, or even need our dog hotel, you can be sure your pup will be well cared for, pampered, and handled with all the love and professionalism in the world.

Get to know them. Really.

Because you and your dog deserve it.
A safe and reliable place to leave your best friend 🐶 …
I trust this place with the love of my life, my dog
Good attention and service

I LOVE this place! My dog ​​Jack always comes back happy and tired. They have great service, they group the dogs according to their behavior, they send you photos all the time, they throw parties for the dogs! I highly recommend it. Alex and Toño are great guys!
Hard to find someone for Mon Ami dog. No response to messages. I wanted my dog to stay here but …. 🫤🤷🏽‍♀️😓 …

My dogs are the happiest, they have different activities every day they go and they spend their time playing with both the other dogs and the staff, I love that they send photos and videos of the furry ones' day.

Highly recommended! My daughter is treated with so much love and care; she's no longer afraid to go. The whole team is incredibly friendly, always attentive, approachable, and very respectful. You can tell they're professional and treat you well from the very first moment.
Terrible service

Chupón (my fur baby) is very happy there. Thank you for taking such good care of him and loving him so much 🫶 You've taken a huge weight off our shoulders, because we work all day and there's no one to look after him during the week. The best part is that you keep us updated with videos and photos you send via WhatsApp throughout the day.

I am extremely disappointed with my experience at Mon Ami Doggie Daycare. I reached out all week to inquire about scheduling an evaluation for my female pitt mix to see if she could be accepted into their daycare. On Monday, they told me they had availability on Friday at 10 a.m., after my older dog’s grooming appointment. However, throughout the week, they never confirmed anything, leaving me in limbo.

Finally, on Friday, they confirmed the grooming appointment for my pitt mix and mentioned they would evaluate her during the grooming session. Once the grooming was complete, I asked how she did, and I was told she was “perfectly fine.” But then, I was shocked when they informed me that despite her great grooming session, they would not allow her to be evaluated for daycare. The reason? Simply because of her breed. They said she was welcome to be groomed, but that was it.

As a Mexican American, I’m especially disappointed. I would expect an establishment like this to be more welcoming to diversity and inclusion. When I first saw the place, I was impressed that they advertised in both Spanish and English, which gave me the impression that it was a welcoming and inclusive environment. But I was sadly mistaken. It’s incredibly disheartening to see that they would make such an unfair decision based on breed rather than behavior.

I am heartbroken for my sweet dog, and I will not be returning. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone who has a pitt mix or any other breed that might face unfair biases. This experience has left me questioning their commitment to inclusion, despite their outward efforts to appear inclusive.

the best doggy daycare in the whole world. when i was moving apartments, i made sure i was in close proximity. my dog beans LOVES it here! the staff are all incredibly friendly and you can tell they absolutely love all the dogs (and my dog loves them all back!) they update me with regular pictures and videos of all the fun my dog is having. prices for daycare are super fair, and they offer grooming and hotel as well. plus i feel so secure knowing there is a vet office on-site in the same building as well.

A few days ago, we went to ask for information, and Alex kindly explained their policies, services, and the differences between this daycare and others, emphasizing that they don't accept aggressive dogs but do accept dogs with anxiety, as well as their understanding and affection for the dogs. However, today when we took our dog for a socialization test, it only lasted 20 minutes instead of the 40 minutes they had told us it would. It's worth noting that my dog ​​suffers from separation anxiety.
When we picked up our dog, the evaluation resulted in a rejection, justifying it by saying he wasn't neutered (they had previously told us this wasn't an impediment). They told us he showed dominance with other males and that this could cause a fight in the short term, disrupting the pack dynamic. They reached this conclusion in just 20 minutes, which, after discussing it with our dog's personal trainer, only demonstrates how unqualified they are to care for a dog that requires more attention.

This is a lovely guarderia, the team are all so sweet with the dogs. They play and engage with the dogs all day.  They create activities and get the dogs playing with each other and socialising. They send updates and little videos via WhatsApp so you can check in with how things are going. I use them as a day care while I'm at work and for occasional over night stays.  They also groom dogs on site and I can say, having a full coated Old English Sheepdog. that they do an amazing job at that too.  It's lovely and clean and most importantly my dog loves going there.  I wouldn't use any where else in the city - thank you to the team!

We are from the US and worked remotely in Condesa/Roma for three months. We are so happy we found Mon Ami Dogi (recommended by an expat on FB). Our two year old Aussie has never been to daycare or been boarded. She did both at Mon Ami Dogi. The staff were incredibly caring, friendly, and communicative.  We received regular updates with photos and videos - including her interacting with other dogs and engaging in enrichment activities. After the first experience, she was happy to go back. I wish we had a Mon Ami Dogi at home. Highly recommend! Thank you to the staff.
It's a very nice place for pets; they're always well cared for. The organization has all the services your dog could need.

I love this place for my dog! I take her there, and they keep it super clean. She always leaves smelling wonderful, and they treat her so well! I'm so happy I found this place because, besides being beautiful, they're very professional, and the price is great for the amazing work they do!
I love taking my dog ​​there; they treat him wonderfully, and the facilities are beautiful. …

The haircut they gave my dog ​​was an insult!!! Don't get your pets' hair cut or bathed there! I asked them to fade the hair from the waist down so her chest and paws would be short... and I sent them a picture of what I wanted. Well, they …
Mina always has a great time when she goes; excellent service and attention.
Excellent dog daycare and grooming
